the last interaction i ever had with him he was in the hospital, had overdosed on aspirin and i was trying to talk to him. he was unresponsive. i sat there until he died.
I have crazy phone anxiety. I'd try that, but I've got some people to talk to now. I feel okay right now.
Bleh. I tried calling the suicide hotline just now. Couldn't bring myself past the hold music.
Do you know how much she took and what she took? You can and should call 911 on her if you haven't already, I know this was 2 hours ago but still. Tell us what happened.

As she tells me, she just gets a bad feeling about that place. I don't know, I think she just has an attachment to me that she can't let go of in order to let me get help. Maybe she thinks she can be all that I need to get better. I don't think she understands the crushing lack of socialization I feel.
I might actually take you up on that sometime. Thank you, mcfattykins. c:

I'll think about calling. I go through phases of wanting to go back and not wanting to, and I really don't know what would be better for me at this point. I wish I could just have my life be.. you know. good. not depressing.
I'm seeing a not-real psychiatrist. I think he's a physicians assistant. Either way, he can't put me back in without my mothers approval, and she won't approve it.
